question.text: Ex-ante expected return of a security with scenarios: Boom (p=0.3, R=15%), Normal (p=0.5, R=10%), Recession (p=0.2, R=2%) is:

explanation.text: The Logic: E(R) = 0.3×15% + 0.5×10% + 0.2×2% = 4.5 + 5.0 + 0.4 = 9.9%. The Trap: 9.0% is arithmetic mean ignoring probabilities; 10% is Normal scenario only. Cross-Exam Context: XV Ch 12; XXI-B tests. Manager's Pro-Tip: Always weight by scenario probability — unweighted averages ignore the probability structure.
